About Timmy's Detailing

A Melbourne detailing workshop, built on coatings expertise

Timmy's Detailing is a premium car detailing business based at 386 Barry Rd, Coolaroo, in Melbourne's north. Its work covers full interior and exterior detailing, paint correction, ceramic coating, paint protection film, window tinting and 3D vehicle scanning.

Its coating credentials are the point of difference: the business states it is one of only three authorised Modesta coating installers in Melbourne, and a Gtechniq Accredited Installer. No founding year is published in the sources used for this page, so none is claimed here.
